remarks: This beautiful 2-bedroom, 2-bath luxury apartment offers an array of features designed for comfortable and convenient living, lots of natural light, high ceilings, open and spacious layout, a bonus room, customized walk-in closets, and a modern kitchen. You'll also enjoy easy access to the covered garage and building amenities such as a receptionist, elevator, clubhouse, and fitness room. Located just minutes away from public transportation and the heart of Stamford, this apartment provides the perfect balance of luxury and convenience
